data.name: Imed
data.gender_notes: Imed is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root ‘‘m-d’’ meaning reward, gift, or return. In Islamic tradition, the name Imed is given to a child as a reminder of the blessings and rewards that Allah bestows upon us. The name Imed carries the meaning “Reward, Gift” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Imed usually hope their child will grow to embody reward, gift and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Imed belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Reward, Gift.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Imed total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
